traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The lamia's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: disguise self (any humanoid form), major image
3/day each: charm person, mirror image, scrying, suggestion
1/day: geas
(Descriptive only: monster spellcasting is slot-based, so this innate list is not a spellcasting entry. No partial spell list. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The lamia makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its dagger or Intoxicating Touch. (Authored: claws and dagger. Intoxicating Touch is not an attack action. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Intoxicating Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is magically cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all ability checks. (Descriptive only: no Wis-disadvantage curse shape. Not a weapon attack, and not a multiattack option. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)
